---
title: "What Blood Tests Taught me about Presenting Data with Context"
date: "2024-01-19"
categories: [workflow]
---

-   Low platelets by themselves were a cause for concern

-   Got many tests done, saw many other specialists

-   Years later, saw a different doctor who considered the fact that I was fit and healthy and concluded that I just had below normal range of platelets but not to be concerned about.
